parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen of the display, primarily made of glass with a plastic or metal frame. It is a flat rectangular component that shows visual output.
parts.Functional_description: The screen functions as the main visual interface of the display, showing images, videos, and text to the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move independently, though it may tilt slightly depending on the base mechanism.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and provides stability on a flat surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the screen upright and may allow for limited rotation or tilt adjustment to optimize viewing angles.
parts.Movement_description: The base may rotate or tilt slightly to adjust the screen position, but it remains stationary during normal use.
